# U.S. News Travel

> > Comprehensive travel destination rankings, guides, and planning resources for travelers exploring North America, the Caribbean, Europe, and Asia.

U.S. News Travel provides expert rankings and detailed destination guides for vacationers, featuring interactive area maps, neighborhood overviews, and curated recommendations for popular destinations including Caribbean islands, Canadian cities, U.S. getaways, and international locations.

## Key Topics

- Destination Rankings
- Caribbean Travel (St. Barts, Anguilla, Martinique)
- Canada Destinations (Quebec City, Montreal, Toronto, Ottawa)
- Area Maps & Neighborhood Guides
- Honeymoon Destinations
- Asia Vacation Spots (Kyoto, Mount Fuji)
- Alaska & Antarctica Travel
- New England Getaways
- France Travel (Nice)
- Royal Caribbean Cruises
- Travel Planning Resources
- City Guides
- U.S. Destinations (Sedona, Newport RI, Burlington VT)

## Destination Rankings

- [Asia Destinations: Rankings](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/asia/): Rankings of best Asia vacation spots including Kyoto and Mount Fuji

## Caribbean Destination Maps

- [St. Barts Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/St_Barts/Area_Map/): Interactive map showing hotels and attractions in St. Barts, Caribbean

## Canada Destination Maps

- [Quebec City Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Quebec_City_Canada/Area_Map/): Neighborhood map of Quebec City showing hotels and key attractions
- [Toronto Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Toronto/Area_Map/): Toronto area map displaying neighborhoods, hotels, and attractions

## U.S. Destination Maps

- [Sedona Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Sedona_AZ/Area_Map/): Sedona, Arizona area map with hotels and attractions near Grand Canyon
- [Newport, RI Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Newport_RI/Area_Map/): Newport, Rhode Island neighborhood map for New England weekend getaways
